# The demo hub

The hub the tests copy: tests/data/hubs/hubs-fixture.ts copies this folder twice into a scratch directory, and the two-hub tests (tests/data/hubs/hub-portfolio.test.ts) build one portfolio from the two copies. It is a synthetic research hub: thirteen projects in six folders (ideas, active, manuscripts, software, coauthor, archive), each carrying its own `tier` (research, personal or software), `stage` and `lead`, and the data files under `.oculus/data/`, at oculus's own paths in the folder of each kind: the registries they point into under `research/`, `pillars/` and `people/`, the career file, the card lists and the Position Leads feed under `academic/`, and the Literature file and the Lit Watch feed under `literature/`. Nothing in it is real.

Its `.oculus/config.yml` names the file of every collection and feed (`collections:`) and sets the cluster. The domains, with their card colours and labels and the one domain that expects a dataset (`graphs`), are `.oculus/data/pillars/domains.yml`'s; the theme words of the venues and the datasets are the options of the `themes` field of `.oculus/data/research/venues.yml` and `.oculus/data/research/data.yml`. `.oculus/data/literature/literature.yml` holds two papers.

The Present view has two decks over this folder: the portfolio deck `deck/` (a title slide, a group that finds every project's `present/` folder and a closing slide, 5 slides with the summary) and the project deck `projects/active/graph-bandits/present/` (a `present.yml` and a `main.md` of `kind: project`).
